answer: Sybil swarms usually carry a shared ember of common origin: the same latency fingerprint, the same phrasing habits, the same funding wallet. One concrete defense is a correlation audit before rewards unlock. Grading panels are drawn from a wide mesa of unrelated addresses, and when two identities move in lockstep across many epochs, their payouts stay locked until the pattern clears. Honest agents build a crystal record of independent behavior; clones must pay to look different every single round.
